weaknesses.title: GREP is substring — unsafe for name:status identity keys
weaknesses.detail: SYS GREP 'api:' on bag containing 'myapi:idle' matches and HEAD returns myapi:idle. Agents that locate-then-SETLINE via GREP silently mutate the wrong row. No field-prefix or ^anchor GREP. Must EACH LINE + BEFORE ':' + EQS for exact name.
weaknesses.repro: roster=myapi:idle; GREP 'api:' → myapi:idle; SETLINE rewrites to api:down

weaknesses.title: No string concat — name:status needs REPLACEALL template
weaknesses.detail: Cannot LET entry = NAME + ':' + STATUS. Program uses REPLACEALL on 'NAME:STATUS' placeholders. If NAME equals 'STATUS' or status embeds placeholder tokens, template corrupts. SYS JOIN is path-only (inserts /).
weaknesses.repro: NAME=STATUS STATUS=idle via template → idle:idle class corruption

weaknesses.title: FINDLINE/HASLINE/REMOVELINE are exact-field only — no prefix find
weaknesses.detail: Cannot FINDLINE bag 'api' to hit 'api:busy'. Update-by-name always needs a secondary walk (EACH+BEFORE) then FINDLINE full line then SETLINE. Verbose for the primary roster use case the ops were meant to unlock.

weaknesses.title: PRINT_JSON collapses multi-line roster bags
weaknesses.detail: PRINT_JSON roster shows api:busyworker:busypeer:ready without separators. Agents must read STATE plate file for structure.

weaknesses.title: WRITE roster often omits final trailing newline
weaknesses.detail: Last field on ROSTER.txt has no trailing NL (cat -A shows no $ on last line). CubalC READ/LINES ok; shell line tools undercount.

weaknesses.title: REMOVELINE removes only first exact match
weaknesses.detail: Duplicate name:status tokens leave residuals after one ack. Agents need loop or UNIQ discipline.

workarounds: EACH LINE + BEFORE ':' + EQS for exact roster name identity (never GREP name:)
REPLACEALL template for name:status; avoid names equal to placeholder tokens
FINDLINE full old_entry then SETLINE idx new_entry
PRINT_JSON scalars only; dump roster via plate path
Bag WRITE for whole roster bag (avoid WRITE+APPEND glue)
language_gaps: Field-prefix match / GREP ^anchor or HASPREFIX line filter
String concatenation (or SYS CAT a b → LAST without path slash)
FINDLINE by key prefix or key=value peel helper
PRINT_JSON escape of newlines in string values
